plain: A writer named Eric Wargo tells podcast host Jesse Michels about an idea from Ed May, a scientist who studied psychic abilities, called decision augmentation theory. As Wargo explains it, the researchers' own ability to sense the future, called precognition, may be what nudges them to start an experiment at just the right moment. If true, it would mean some surprising lab results come from good timing guided by a glimpse of the future.
